GeekClaw v5.0.24 - Customer Service Home Fix

What's changed
- The AI Customer Service entry (/customer-service) now opens the agent workbench directly instead of the roster card page.
- When entering Customer Service, it automatically picks the first enabled agent and navigates to /customer-service/:id/workbench.
- If no agent exists, a create-agent prompt is shown and the user is taken to the workbench after creation.
- The workbench header now includes:
  - A "Manage agents" button back to the roster (/customer-service/roster).
  - An agent switcher dropdown to jump between agents.
  - Direct links to Channels and Tickets.
- The roster page is kept as the management backend under /customer-service/roster.

Fixes
- Fixes the wrong default landing page where users saw the old agent roster instead of the operator workbench after clicking "AI客服".

Known limitations
- The workbench still operates on a single agent scope. Aggregate multi-agent workbench and auto-assignment are planned for a future release.
